info.title: Quantura
info.description: Probabilistic market forecasts, verified market discovery, observed historical data, and screener quantiles. Forecasts run asynchronously: create a job, poll its status, then download the final ensemble. Enterprise agreements define compute admission and API quotas. Market data remains subject to provider coverage and licensing. Research estimates are not guaranteed returns.

get.summary: Read newly observed prices to overlay a saved forecast
get.description: Returns genuine selected-side targets (Kalshi closing ask, Polymarket US display quote) or stock closes after the immutable input cutoff. The first prediction-row minute is retained when available, even outside the most recent 500 observations; worker completion does not move this comparison to another minute. A quote preceding publication is retrospective, not a backdated fill. Stock rows include interval and exchange session_date metadata; minute closes are not final daily closes. Does not run models or revise predictions. Poll no faster than once per minute. Stock overlays have no fixed 90-day cutoff-age limit: retained forecast-interval closes support 120/180-day replays, bounded to 2,000 rows; recent stock minutes use a seven-day window. Prediction-market and perpetual live overlays expire 90 days after input cutoff and expose their availability state. Provider retention still applies. Dataset-only jobs return no live observations.

rapidApiKey.name: X-RapidAPI-Key
rapidApiKey.description: Your RapidAPI application key. RapidAPI supplies the API-specific gateway credential privately. A private enterprise CUSTOM subscription is required.

transform.description: Prediction-market sources enforce bounded logit forecasting, with epsilon 1e-6 at transform boundaries.

frequency.description: Canonical market intervals: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 1h, 4h, 1D, 1W-MON, 1MS. source.frequency determines market input bars; series/workspace datasets can also use validated pandas offsets.

analytics_context.description: Optional consented website telemetry; sanitized separately from model configuration and excluded from cache identity. Invalid or unavailable telemetry does not block forecasting.

history_lag_minutes.description: Input cutoff before request time, in minutes (hours × 60; days × 1440). Select up to 500 observations BEFORE cutoff. Source retention still applies. No fixed 90-day cutoff-age cap: 120 days is 172800 minutes; 180 days is 259200 minutes. Availability depends on provider retention. Positive values create a historical replay, not a previously published forecast. Later observations are separate overlays.

toto_variant.description: Approved Toto size, smallest to largest. Only relevant when Toto is enabled. The server pins the checkpoint and revision, including in the cache identity; clients cannot submit arbitrary model repositories. All sizes require at least 32 observed values.

history_cutoff_at.description: Optional past absolute cutoff with timezone offset (ISO 8601), subject to available source history. Cannot be combined with a positive history_lag_minutes. Browser calendar values convert from the user's device timezone to UTC.

prediction_end_at.description: Optional absolute end date/time. After input materialization, the server derives the number of forecast bars only for completed future interval boundaries through this time (never rounded past the requested end), still subject to 512 and model-specific limits. NYSE daily forecasts use real exchange sessions in the selected calendar window. Overrides prediction_length.

price_side.description: Dukascopy quote side, persisted for refresh and observations.

limit.description: Maximum latest valid observations before cutoff. Model minimum history requirements still apply.

frequency.description: Only completed observations. Weekly/monthly closes aggregate real daily bars on Monday UTC / first-of-month UTC boundaries. Calendar months are never approximated as 30 days.

adjustment.description: Provider price adjustment. The selected provider must support the requested adjustment.

feed.description: Alpaca defaults to iex; other feeds require provider entitlement. The selected basis is persisted for overlays and refreshes.

symbol.description: Provider market slug (Polymarket US) or market ticker (Kalshi).

contract_id.description: Exact selected side ID from market lookup; verified server-side.

limit.description: Maximum latest genuine observations after phase, cutoff and time-window filtering. Fewer are used if unavailable; missing bars are never filled. Model minimums apply.

history_phase.description: The website defaults to auto: pregame plus in-game before 32 elapsed game minutes, then in-game only, evaluated at the input cutoff. Missing event start keeps auto on both; explicit phase-specific requests require a verified start. Existing API clients retain both when omitted.

history_lookback_minutes.description: 0 imposes no extra time restriction; positive values restrict elapsed history before cutoff. For pregame, the window ends at the earlier of cutoff and game start. source.limit then selects the latest N genuine observations.

oneOf.description: Kalshi perpetual forecast on normalized USD-per-underlying-unit trade closes. Set horizon_mode=frequency_periods and calendar=NONE; price transforms auto/log/none, never logit. Source, units and contract scaling are resolved by the server.

analysis_mode.description: New jobs provide forecast quantiles without buy/sell classifications. Historical saved jobs remain readable.

quantiles.description: Canonical decimal quantile string to final ensemble value.

HistoricalForecastValidation.description: Optional legacy historical-validation summary preserved on older results. New forecast requests and reproductions do not run a holdout or delay completion for metrics. These legacy scores describe a separate forecast, not the requested future predictions.

smape.description: Ratio, not percent; the UI multiplies by 100. Zero/zero contributes zero.

average_wql.description: Mean twice-pinball loss divided by total absolute actual values; null for all-zero actuals.

EconomicSeriesSource.description: Select one series and one value for every required dimension. Reporting periods are daily, month-end, quarter-end, or year-end. Current revised data is not a point-in-time vintage. BigQuery history additionally requires time_field and value_field, uses only bigquery-public-data, exact parameterized filters, a dry run and a 100 MiB billed-byte cap.

GeminiSpotSource.description: Verified Gemini exchange spot symbol. Only completed candles returned by the provider's bounded recent window are available.
